Voice input is optional and works only when you tap a mic. Where this device offers on-device speech recognition, speech is recognised on the device. Otherwise, if you installed Itera\'s offline speech model for this language, Itera recognises speech on the phone itself; audio never leaves the device. Otherwise, and only if you allow it, Android\'s system speech service or a speech recognition app you choose is used, which may process or transmit audio remotely under its own privacy terms. On Android 13 and later Itera may capture the microphone itself and pass the audio straight to that service; it stays in memory only for that phrase. Itera never saves, uploads or logs audio and never keeps what you said, only the text you accept, like typing. You can change or turn these off in Settings.
